events.title: Vino Noceto | Holiday Sip & Paint
events.description: Get into the holiday spirit with Heart & Soul Studio! Join us at Vino Noceto for a festive crafting session where you’ll create an adorable rustic Mason Jar Snowman! It’s the perfect excuse to get a little crafty, embrace the holiday season, and add some handmade charm to your décor!

events.title: Live Music Friday at Rombauer Vineyards
events.description: With fun live music and delicious food trucks, we’re kicking the weekend off early in Plymouth. Call your friends and join us! CJ Washington returns for a cozy November afternoon! Enjoy delicious bites from our featured food truck paired with your favorite Rombauer wines, and browse unique local vendors.

events.title: Black Friday at Iron Hub
events.description: Make Iron Hub part of your Black Friday plans! Stop by for special offers, enjoy small bites, and find a bottle or two for your holiday table or gift list. We look forward to seeing you at the winery!

events.title: Holiday Wreath Making at Fraser Family Vineyards
events.description: Join us for some festive creativity and wine! Handmade grapevine wreaths from Fraser Family vines and winter holiday-themed decorations will be provided. Wine and light bites are included as well! Sign up by November 27th at https://fraserfamilyvineyards.com/shop/
